name: Signup Form Developer
summary: A software developer building the account-creation/registration form for a web or mobile product.
description: Owns the signup experience: validating that an email address is structurally well-formed before creating an account (validation.validate-email), and giving a new user real-time, actionable feedback on password strength so a weak password is caught before the account is created rather than after (validation.score-password-strength). This is specifically the identity/credential-creation step of a product, before any purchase or transaction exists for the user.

distinguished_from.how: Works on account creation, before the user has any purchase intent -- not the payment/shipping flow, which only exists for a user who already has an account.
Works on a product's signup form specifically, not its core note-taking/productivity feature -- a different feature area even if the product happened to be the same app.
